HiBy R3 Pro II · Rockbox · 480 × 720

Adwaitapod R3 Preview

The first build of adwaitapod-r3, a portrait touch redesign of adwaitapod, in its light and dark variants. Rendered by the Rockbox UI simulator for the R3 Pro II, which runs the same skin engine as the player.

Light · adwaitapod-r3

Dark · adwaitapod-r3-dark

Touch controls

  • Now Playing: tap play to play or pause, hold it to stop. Tap previous or next to skip, hold to rewind or fast-forward. Tap shuffle or repeat to toggle.
  • Tap or drag along the seek bar to jump. Hold the album art for the track's context menu.
  • Tap the back arrow (top left) to return: to the main menu from Now Playing, up one level in menus.
  • Home: drag the volume slider; tap Shuffle or Repeat. While playing, tap the track for Now Playing or its button to pause.
  • Other menus: tap the mini player for Now Playing, or its button to pause.
  • Quick screen (flick down from the top edge on Now Playing): drag the volume slider, tap a brightness preset; tap the arrow to close.
  • Changing the volume on Now Playing shows a volume pop-up over the seek bar.

What changed from adwaitapod

  • Every screen redesigned for a 480×720 portrait touchscreen (adwaitapod is made for the iPod's 320×240 landscape screen and click wheel).
  • The home screen's side panel moved below the list. Its volume, shuffle and repeat widgets became touch controls.
  • Added Now Playing touch controls, a mini player in menus and a back button in the status bar.
  • Battery percentage in the status bar on every screen.
  • Same palette, Cantarell font and Adwaita icons, redrawn at sizes for a 218 ppi screen. The lock screen wallpaper is generated.
  • Not carried over: the preferences screens, always-on display, radio and recording screens and extra languages.

Still to check on the player

  • Text sizes and touch targets with a finger.
  • Volume slider range, and that the brightness presets change the screen.
  • Speed of redraws with the backdrop layer, and the flick that opens the quick screen.
Based on adwaitapod by Dook (GPL-3.0). Icons from GNOME's Adwaita icon theme (LGPL-3.0). Cantarell by the Cantarell authors (SIL OFL 1.1). Test tracks are silent placeholders.
